PAYMENT METHODS

Three ways to pay your OLT filing fees.

Keep each option separate, explain the tradeoffs up front, and avoid making customers discover a bank-product fee at the end of the filing process.

DIRECT PAYMENT

Credit Card

Standard OLT fees apply

Pay OLT fees securely using a major credit card.

  • Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express accepted
  • Immediate direct payment
  • No Refund Transfer bank-product fee
DIGITAL WALLET

PayPal

Standard OLT fees apply

Use a PayPal account to make your payment.

  • PayPal account required
  • PayPal accepts major credit cards
  • Return to OLT after payment to complete tax filing
REFUND TRANSFER

Pay by Refund

$29.95 additional fee

Have authorized fees deducted from your federal income-tax refund after it arrives.

  • No credit card required
  • Refund Transfer offered by Green Dot Bank, Member FDIC
  • Tax refund and e-filing are required
  • $29.95 plus other applicable OLT fees

PAYMENT SECURITY

Reassurance where customers need it.

Payment pages should reduce anxiety, not create it. Put payment-security and process guidance immediately next to the choices.

Secure payment flow

Major credit-card payments are accepted through OLT's payment process.

PayPal handoff

Customers using PayPal must return to OLT afterward so payment is received and filing can be completed.

Refund Transfer disclosure

Clearly distinguish the Green Dot Bank deposit product from a standard OLT payment.
